article_help_queue_identity.name: article_help_queue_identity
article_help_queue_identity.value: ("article_help_queue_claims"."article_id" IS NULL AND "article_help_queue_claims"."handoff_id" IS NULL AND "article_help_queue_claims"."event_id" IS NULL AND "article_help_queue_claims"."claim_hash" IS NULL) OR ("article_help_queue_claims"."article_id" IS NOT NULL AND "article_help_queue_claims"."handoff_id" IS NOT NULL AND "article_help_queue_claims"."event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "article_help_queue_claims"."claim_hash" IS NOT NULL AND length("article_help_queue_claims"."claim_hash")=64)

article_purge_serial_hashes.name: article_purge_serial_hashes

dedao_batch_native_identity.name: dedao_batch_native_identity

dedao_dispatch_identity.name: dedao_dispatch_identity
dedao_dispatch_identity.value: "dedao_dispatches"."state" NOT IN ('created','stopped') OR ("dedao_dispatches"."thread_id" IS NOT NULL AND "dedao_dispatches"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "dedao_dispatches"."turn_id" IS NOT NULL AND "dedao_dispatches"."creation_json" IS NOT NULL)

local_word_queue_identity.name: local_word_queue_identity
